Sending the same CV to every job?
That's why the calls aren't coming.
Many employers use software that scans your CV for the words in their job post.
Miss them, and a recruiter may never see it.
Here's the fix. It takes under a minute.
Search for a job you want, and open the listing.
Paste it into [Skilleaze](/skˈɪliːz/), and tap once.
Your CV is rewritten for that exact role, using only what's already true about you.
Check your match score, and add the skills you really have.
Then download it as PDF or Word, and apply.
One CV. Tailored for every job.
